The process is still the same. 
[b]New applicants:[/b] Fill out the form here: [url=https://forms.gle/zmCbfXdbVbqABbtcA]https://forms.gle/zmCbfXdbVbqABbtcA[/url]

Gear up, pilots. The bridge has been intact for too long!

notes.title: Bridge Hunter Closed Test
notes.notes:
Greetings pilots! Today, we're thrilled to announce that we are now accepting applications for the closed test!
As we create more content, mechanics, and features, there's a higher risk of something not working as intended. That's why we need you! We seek feedback on the game's performance, bugs, feel, and experience to determine our focus points before the early access release.

What do you get in return? First of all, you get to try the game before anyone else and leave your impact on the project. On top of that, you get to keep a copy of the game on release. And, of course, you get our HUGE thanks!

Interested?
Fill out a quick application form: https://forms.gle/zmCbfXdbVbqABbtcA

Please note that at this point, we're only looking for a very small number of testers, so you might not be selected right away. However, your form will be saved, meaning we might contact you later when we expand testing. Stay tuned for more news!

notes.title: What about the game?
notes.notes:
Our team is way past our first planned release date of August 2023 and also missed our internal second deadline for October...
To begin with, we'd like to apologize to those who've been waiting for our game. The work is still in progress; we're not planning to abandon the project. So, no worries, you'll get to try out Bridge Hunter eventually! 
The prolonged silence is because we lost access to all of our equipment back in October and managed to renew the workflow just recently. At this point, the work continues and we're looking forward to releasing the game in a near future.

Stay tuned for the updates, and don't forget to wishlist Bridge Hunter if you haven't yet!

notes.title: 32 Years of Freedom
notes.notes:
On August 24, 1991, Ukraine finally obtained its independence from the Soviet Empire. For hundreds of years, many generations have been fighting for this day. Today, we celebrate the 32nd anniversary, and coincidentally, this day also marks a year and a half since the beginning of the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. 

Millions of people have been struggling during this time. Many lost their homes, and some lost their lives. While the global community is focused on finishing the war, people around the globe are starting to get distracted with other things. Everyday news about celebrities, technology, business, etc., is replacing the horrors of the war that is still going on. Everyone is tired, but you can’t tune out genocide and pretend nothing is happening.

We highly encourage you to support volunteers providing help to people in need in Ukraine. You can choose your local organization if you know that it is trustworthy, or donate to big reputable foundations like [url=https://u24.gov.ua/]U24[/url], [url=https://savelife.in.ua/en/]Come Back Alive[/url] or [url=https://prytulafoundation.org/en]Serhiy Prytula Charity Foundation[/url].
You can also join an ongoing fundraiser held by the [url=https://ukrainian.games/]Ukrainian Games Festival[/url], which we’re a part of!

notes.title: Status of development.
notes.notes:
Recently there was a lot of progress made in the game's development process. We've added more exciting mechanics than planned, some content and core features etc. As we keep working on the game, our vision changes, and we develop new ideas; we also get many suggestions from testers and the audience. Although we can't implement all the concepts, considering the development is going faster than planned, we've decided to increase the game's scope and add more stuff before releasing it into early access. 
For you, it means a more extensive, nicer-looking and more polished game. But considering the amount of content planned, it is likely that the early access release is expected to be moved further in time. We're still hoping to deliver the game in August, as promised, but if we decide to move the release date - we will make another post about it.
Meanwhile, join your Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/cSsBA3B3sf]via this link[/url] to keep up with the development process and join the growing community!
